integrity: The proof is exact and symbolic. The accompanying verifier uses only exact rational arithmetic as a secondary replay; no finite computation is used to justify an infinite step. Literature comparisons are limited to the explicitly inspected sources and searches.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only critical orbits of integral quadratics on the three nonwandering boundary classes and does not alter the quantitative wandering-case theorem. A more specific MSC2020 subdivision is not asserted because the lead preprint's public first version supplies primary number-theory classification but not a printed MSC2020 code.
title: Exact square-hit sets on the nonwandering critical boundary of integral quadratics
